name: Legion (VST3, in development)
description: One voice in, a choir of it out. Up to four copies, each with its own pitch AND its own body size, because a voice shifted without separating those two is a chipmunk rather than a singer. FOLLOW decides how much the body rides the note, so the same person can sing higher instead of becoming a cartoon. HUMANISE gives each copy uncorrelated detune, level shimmer and timing stagger, which is the difference between a section and a stack. The Brokild World rack sits on the harmony bus by default, so it grinds the copies and leaves the lead alone. Measured but not yet heard: 113 engine checks pass and nobody has put a scream through it.
note: Windows VST3 · in development · free download · 4 voices · independent pitch and formant · BWFX rack · source included.
